messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
According to the manual of the MA STAR two-post lift, within what maximum interval must the spindle lubrication felt be replaced?

response.text: Secondo il manuale del ponte sollevatore a due colonne MA STAR, entro quale intervallo massimo deve essere sostituito il feltro di lubrificazione della vite?
